data.gender_notes: Mawah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Mawah means 'one who is seeking, yearning, longing, or desiring'. It is derived from the root word 'awwah', which signifies a strong desire or craving. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes the continuous search for knowledge, spiritual growth, and the love of Allah. The name Mawah carries the meaning “Seeking, yearning, longing” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mawah usually hope their child will grow to embody seeking, yearning, longing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
